I came across this game randomly on steam store and decided to give it a shot. Pros: - Some cool mechanics such as the "weeping angel" human doll - Majority of items you find are useful - Procedural generation - Some events are kinda cool/scary - You have options for "countering" the monsters such as stunning them or hiding etc.. Cons: - Gets repetitive super quick - ^ the game only has 1 map. - Monster AI needs work, when you hide in lockers you will most likely get camped for minutes till they decide to go away. It gets annoying. - I am not sure about other perks, but the "faster speed while crouched" perk was basically unnoticeable. Felt lackluster. - No voice chat. Bugs/issues (so far for 2 hours): - I found 1 instance of text that was still in chinese - Character selection is bugged, you would select one and it would give you another one. Overall, 6/10

As a horror game enthusiast, I found this game to hold significant promise, despite some notable areas that require improvement. First Impressions: Upon initial exploration, the game adheres to the conventions of horror gaming: an initial phase of familiarizing oneself with the mechanics while navigating through eerie environments, evading ominous entities such as mannequins or spectral samurais. My first successful completion of the entry-level stage clocked in at 71 minutes, during which I gained a rudimentary understanding of the game's inner workings. Subsequent playthroughs revealed a certain predictability in enemy behavior and patterns, which, while not unexpected, somewhat dampened the initial thrill. Nonetheless, the multiplayer experience injected a fresh layer of enjoyment, particularly when accompanied by friends—especially those with a predisposition to fear. Areas for Improvement: One noticeable drawback lies in the random pathing of enemy entities, which often results in a repetitive and easily exploitable pattern. Evading detection, even with a flashlight active, proved overly simplistic, as hiding behind environmental objects, such as tables, rendered encounters trivial. Furthermore, disparities in graphical optimization were apparent, with discrepancies in visibility between varying graphical settings—posing a potential disadvantage for players with lower-end hardware. Conclusion: While the foundation of the game exhibits promise, its current state leaves room for substantial enhancement. I eagerly anticipate future updates from the developers, which could include the introduction of additional content to enrich the player experience. Suggestions for improvement include diversifying enemy behaviors and patterns, expanding the game environment to encompass diverse locales such as schoolyards or cafeterias, and addressing prevalent issues such as graphical optimization and bug fixes. Such refinements hold the potential to elevate the game to a more fulfilling and immersive horror experience.

The game is good but I believe the monsters need some improvements, I feel it's very problematic because they commonly camp near you not letting you go where you need constantly keeping you in 1 room as your sanity drains quickly. The monsters also commonly end up following the same paths but just in opposite sides cornering you in and they really like hanging around near you. I was only playing Normal mode with my friend, it didn't really feel like the difficulty it was because of what was happening.

I love everything about the game, the monsters, the atmosphere, the environment except the monsters AI which is pretty bad and most of the times they corner you on the side of the map and you cannot escape because they move around in the same place. Do I recommend this game? Yes, the game is great but it needs some fixes.

I'll try to be careful in this review and not spoil too much, but give a little insight and share my euphoria about the game. I have played many horror games on Steam, but I can say that this one is the scariest of them all. No game has managed to make me feel uneasy in my stomach like this one. It's really worth trying out. The procedural generation makes no two levels the same, and yet the levels build up in a straight line so that you pass each station to open the exit. The entities can be a real pain at times, and of course they camp you, especially the human body puppet that only walks when you look away. However, you have a variety of strategic items to incapacitate or distract entities for a short or longer period of time, very ingenious and super interesting in multiplayer. Last but not least, we have small RPG elements, there are perks that you can train and use with the coins you earn to make your life a little easier. Clear recommendation to buy, no noticeable bugs found, very good graphics and creepy atmosphere, it's definitely worth the price of the game to try it.

可以是蛮可以的 优劣点都有 但总体来说优点比缺点多的多 先说个bug吧 如果你不是主机 且你延迟挺高 如捡东西会延迟进入背包 那么这个时候你就狂点鼠标拾取 在你网络延迟捡东西的期间 你点多少下你就能获得多少个当前捡的物品 然后丢了重新刷 理论上获得了一个可堆叠的物品就等于无限当前物品 刷警报器疯狂丢搞朋友很爽 灭火器护身符这种有延迟也可以刷 但是需要沟通倒数 几乎同时捡 但必须是网卡的那个先捡 另外一个需要在服务器延迟相应之前这几秒钟【根据延迟决定时间 我一般是0.8s延迟 当然很卡的时候可以到3秒】同样捡一次 推荐网卡的倒数 另外一个配合的不要抢拍 在1出来后立马点鼠标 别的的话 要么就是攻略要么就是心得 我懒得多打字 对我来说 我是很推荐入手的 这种系列的恐游唯独这个让我玩的最久也时常想起 上手后游戏几乎没难度 目前也是全难度通关 希望能出新地图
